name: Instagram Booking Bot — Nail Studio Kyiv OB

parameters.toolDescription: Check Google Calendar for busy periods on a date. Returns busy time ranges. Use these to find free slots within master work hours. Input: date as YYYY-MM-DD string.

Create Google Calendar event for confirmed booking. Inputs: summary (string like Манікюр класичний - Олена), start_datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00), end_datetime (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00), description (booking details string).

Save booking to database after calendar event created. Inputs: master_id (UUID), service_id (UUID), date (YYYY-MM-DD), start_time (HH:MM), end_time (HH:MM), google_event_id (id field from Create Calendar Event response). client_id is auto-filled.
